# signet-credentials

> Consumers that need a player's Signet display name, or need to validate an
> inbound credential before trusting it, end up re-implementing the same relay
> subscription, Schnorr check and `expiration`-tag read. signet-credentials is
> the consumer SDK for the Signet credential profile (kind 31000) on Nostr:
> publish, fetch, parse and validate credential events in one library.

For developers building on the [Signet](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet)
protocol who need to read or write kind-31000 credential events without
hand-rolling relay queries and signature checks. `signet-protocol` is the core
types and crypto layer; `signet-credentials` is the profile-level consumer
library built on it.

## Getting Started

```bash
npm install signet-credentials signet-protocol
```

```typescript
import { fetchPersonaHandle } from 'signet-credentials'

const result = await fetchPersonaHandle('<pubkey-hex>', {
  relayUrls: ['wss://relay.example.com'],
})

if (result.status === 'ok') {
  console.log(result.credential.displayName)
}
```

## Key Concepts

- **Credential profile**: this package scopes to the `persona-name` profile
  of the Signet kind-31000 credential (`type: 'self' | 'peer' | 'professional'`).
  Other profiles (`age-scope`, `professional`, `supersession`) are planned but
  not yet implemented.
- **Fail-closed vs fail-open**: `parseValidPersonaName` is fail-closed (returns
  `null` on any problem); `fetchPersonaHandle` returns a discriminated
  `FetchPersonaHandleResult` so callers can distinguish "no credential" from
  "relay unreachable" and avoid rendering a false "no name set".
- **`expiration` tag**: credentials use NIP-40's `['expiration', '<unix>']`
  tag; an expired credential is treated as invalid, not as valid-forever.
- **No default relay**: `relayUrls` is always caller-supplied; the library
  does not bake in an operator's relay.

## API Surface

Barrel import from `signet-credentials`, or the subpath
`signet-credentials/persona-name`:

- `fetchPersonaHandle(pubkey, opts)`: query relays in parallel, return a
  discriminated `FetchPersonaHandleResult`.
- `parseValidPersonaName(event)`: parse, validate and check expiry in one
  fail-closed call.
- `buildPersonaNameCredential(privateKey, displayName, opts)`: build and sign
  a credential event (does not publish).
- `parsePersonaName(event)`: pure parse, no validation.
- `validatePersonaCredential(event)`: structural and Schnorr check, returns
  `{valid, errors[]}`.
